title: Giants cornerback Paulson Adebo skipped first day of voluntary offseason work

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Giants cornerback Paulson Adebo skipped first day of voluntary offseason work
sources.description: Giants cornerback Paulson Adebo was one of three players on the roster who didn't attend the first day of voluntary offseason workouts today — and the only one whose reasons for missing the workout weren't explained to head coach John Harbaugh.
